purpose: Quiet inline dot-and-word status for a live connection, telling connecting, live, reconnecting, polling, stale, out-of-date, and closed apart by shape and text, not color alone.
useWhen: Surfacing the transport-level health of a websocket, SSE stream, or polling loop as a compact, self-contained dot and word.
Distinguishing push (`live`) from interval polling (`polling`) so operators don't mistake one for the other.

avoidWhen.reason: Annotating a static entity's state (a row, a user, a deployment) rather than a live transport — use status-dot instead.
Rendering a full event log with per-event connection transitions — use feed's log arm instead.

notes: Status is conveyed by shape and text together, never color alone (WCAG 1.4.1): live is a dot, out-of-date a hollow ring, the rest an icon. The live pulsing dot collapses to a static dot under prefers-reduced-motion.
